purpose: #197: a Verilog-A module that uses the value of an unregistered $systf is refused by name (UnregisteredSystf).

oracle.derivation: LRM 12.32 leaves a $name no standard defines to a VPI application and fixes no value for one nobody registered; ESPice loads no application, so any value it used would be invented. AGENTS.md 2.7.6: refuse by name.
